doc: Daily iron supplementation in children 24–59 months of age in malaria-endemic areas

entries.claim: 在贫血患病率≥40%的地区，对24-59月龄学龄前儿童每日补铁可作为公共卫生干预措施，以提高血红蛋白浓度和改善铁状态。
entries.source_doc: Daily iron supplementation in children 24–59 months of age in malaria-endemic areas

entries.claim: 在疟疾流行区，应对婴幼儿和儿童进行铁补充，同时配合预防、诊断和治疗疟疾的公共卫生措施。
entries.source_doc: Daily iron supplementation in children 24–59 months of age in malaria-endemic areas
